findings.issue: וּלְמִבֵּית is and + to + from + house (construct). “lo” adds a thing the tokens do not license, and “dentro” drops house and from.
H6532 is a common noun; “parójet” leaves it untranslated instead of Spanish.

notes: 2mp guardarán/servirán and su match ustedes; gift-service order and hophal “será muerto” stay inside the tokens.
